There was a time I believed in that. So much so, my colleague Mina Bonteri and I put forth a treaty with Separatists and Republic senators alike to end the war. Your Supreme Chancellor rejected it. I realized then, peace was never an option.|Tawni Ames|}} '''Tawni Ames''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] who served as the [[governor]] of [[Desix]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. ==Biography== ===Clone Wars=== {{Quote|Dooku was right in the end. He knew the Republic was corrupt, that it would collapse and become something worse. He saw it coming. The Galactic Empire.|Tawni Ames|}} During the [[Clone Wars]], Tawni Ames and her [[homeworld]] of [[Desix]] sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Ames would work with the [[Separatist Senate]], and when her colleague, [[Senator]] [[Mina Bonteri]] of [[Onderon]] put forth the [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative]], a treaty suggesting the beginning of peace negotiations between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the Separatist movement, Ames supported her. However, a number of factors, namely the [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid|bombing]] of Republic capital planet [[Coruscant]]'s [[Central power distribution grid]] and Bonteri's [[assassin]]ation, resulted in the treaty's revocation.{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}} The failure of this attempt for peace convinced Ames that the Republic never intended for the war to actually end and enforced her faith in the Separatist [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s movement. ===Imperial Era=== {{Quote|I'm Tawni Ames. The rightful governor.''"
"''We have official Imperial orders.''"
"''Desix separated from the Republic years ago, Commander. We are an independent system. Once your government acknowledges this, Grotton and his soldiers will be handed over. Those are my terms.''"
"''We're not here to debate politics with you.''"
"''If you did, you might see how unjust your actions are.|Tawni Ames and Imperial Commander Cody|}} [[File:Tawni_ames_armed.png|thumb|290x290px|Tawni Ames personally took governor Grotton and his stormtroopers hostage upon their arrival to Desix City]] Following the [[Proclamation of the New Order]] and the Republic's transformation into the [[Galactic Empire]], Ames led her planet into independence, serving as the [[governor]]. In the months following the rise of the Empire sent the first Imperial governor, [[Grotton]], to assume his position in Desix City. Ames refused to surrender her planet to the Empire, claiming that Desix had separated from the Empire's predecessor early in the war and that the Imperial government had therefore no claim to the planet. Ignoring Grotton's objections, she ordered a contingent of [[B1-series battle droid]]s from the planet's [[Desix Separatist holdout|army]] to take him and his [[TK stormtrooper]] escort into custody. When news of the governor's kidnapping reached Coruscant, [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart|Rampart]] tasked [[genetically defective clone]] [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair" and [[Clone trooper|clone stormtrooper]] [[Clone Commander|commander]] [[Cody|CC-2224]] "Cody" to extract him from his captivity in Desix City and restore Imperial order to the planet. Despite the mission being disguised as a diplomatic convoy, Ames correctly guessed its military nature and had her [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Desix)|T-series droid]] commander order the [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|shuttle]] carrying Cody's unit shot down. She then took Grotton with her to the city's [[Desix Bell Tower|Bell Tower]] as the surviving clones from the extraction team were ambushing her forces outside. Eventually, Crosshair, Cody, "[[Nova (clone trooper)|Nova]]," and "[[Wyler]]" reached the Bell Tower's steps, at which point Tawni ordered her remaining [[BX-series droid commando]] droids and [[droideka]]s to attack them. Cody and Crosshair took down the droids and the T-series commander in one shot from Crosshair's [[sniper rifle]] with the help of Cody, throwing one of Crosshair's mirror discs. [[File:TawniAmesHoldsGrottonHostage.png|thumb|left|300px|Tawni Ames holding Grotton hostage]] With the clones now in the bell tower, Ames came out of the shadows holding Grotton with a [[blaster]] to his head and pleaded with Cody to allow her planet to stay free. She claimed that once the Empire recognized her people's right to rule themselves the governor and his forces would be freed. Cody reminded her that her forces shot down their vessel and killed many of his clones, to which she replied that they were merely defending themselves. However, Cody convinced her to release Grotton by laying down his [[DC-15A blaster carbine|weapon]] and explaining that he and she had both survived one major war and he did not wish for them to start another. Immediately after he was released, Grotton ordered Cody to execute the rogue governor, to Cody's despair. Ames, unsurprised, told Cody that this was the peace the Empire was bringing. Immediately after, Crosshair shot and [[Death|killed]] her. ==Personality and traits== During the Clone War, Tawni Ames, alongside the people of her homeworld of Desix were strong supporters of the Separatists. Ames backed Mina Bonteri when she proposed the Confederate–Republic peace initiative, a treaty suggesting the beginning of peace negotiations between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist movements. After the negotiations led to the bombing of Republic capital planet Coruscant's Central power distribution grid and Bonteri's assassination, Ames became convinced the Republic never intended for peace and the end of the war. She therefore put all her faith in the Separatist Count Dooku's movement. When Grotton and TK stormtroopers landed outside Desix City during the Imperial Era, demanding Ames relinquished her position, Ames declared she was the rightful governor of Desix, before arresting Grotton and his troops. She later commanded a second offensive against the Empire when Commander Cody, Crosshair and a unit of Imperial clone stormtroopers launched a counteroffensive to retake the planet and install Grotton as the new governor. She instructed her T-series tactical droid to lead her droid forces during the battle. After Cody and Crosshair destroyed all of Ames forces, including the tactical droid, she held a blaster at gunpoint to Grotton's head, while she attempted to reason with Cody and Crosshair, despite Grotton ordering Cody to execute her. She demanded that the Empire recognized Desix as an independent system, in exchange for the return of Grotton and his troops. Cody insisted they could negotiate peacefully. However, she told Cody peace was never an option, as proven by the death of Mina Bonteri. Once Grotton was freed, Ames told Cody that he did so much for 'peace,' just before Crosshair followed Grotton's order, executing her. Tawni Ames was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]], with [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s and tan skin. ==Equipment== Ames was armed with a blaster. She wore a gold and dark blue uniform, with a gold and dark blue helmet, and a gold and dark blue [[rank insignia plaque]]. She also had gold bars on her gloves, belt and boots. Ames also utilized a pair of [[macrobinoculars]]. ==Behind the scenes== Ames' name was revealed in the closed captions of the trailer for the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' released on [[December 7]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|R15uYFpeBG0|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Season 2 | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/season-2-official-trailer-star-wars-the-bad-batch}} In the [[Disney+]] release of the trailer, she was credited simply as "governor."[[:File:BB-Season2Trailer-Governor.png|Disney+ captions]] She was voiced by [[Tasia Valenza]]. ==Appearances== *{{TBB|The Solitary Clone}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|R15uYFpeBG0|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Season 2 | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/season-2-official-trailer-star-wars-the-bad-batch}} {{1stp}} *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}} *{{SW|url=news/dee-bradley-baker-cody-the-bad-batch|text=''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'': Dee Bradley Baker on the Return of Commander Cody – Exclusive}} {{Imo}} *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/the-solitary-clone-episode-guide|text="The Solitary Clone" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} *{{InsiderCite|issue1=219|issue2=220|Star Wars: The Bad Batch: The Anatomy of Animation|''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'': The Anatomy of Animation}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|desix|Desix}} *{{Databank|tawni-ames|Tawni Ames}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Tawni Ames |fr=Tawni Ames |ja=トーニ・エイムズ |ka=ტოუნი ეიმსი }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ames, Tawni}} [[Category:Confederacy of Independent Systems planetary leaders]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Separatist holdouts individuals]]
